items.description: Notify the relevant parties about the medevac that took place at Benoa anchorage on 2026-10-08, with the launch at 15:30 and the vessel resuming passage at 17:40.
Update the vessel schedule for VSL-18 to reflect the new ETA after the 6.5 hours deviation due to the medevac on 2026-10-08.
Notify the relevant parties about the updated vessel schedule for VSL-18 following the medevac and the resumed passage at 17:40 on 2026-10-08.
